sections.heading: house rules
sections.intro: cabin fever is delicate. help us preserve it.

bullets.label: respect others
bullets.text: zero tolerance for discrimination or harassment in any form. violators will be escorted from the venue. not here, not anywhere

bullets.label: respect space
bullets.text: zero tolerance for theft or vandalism. our cabin is not your cabin. violators will be escorted at the discretion of the organizers

bullets.label: leave no trace
bullets.text: all personal belongings must be removed after the party

bullets.label: no BYOB alcohol
bullets.text: food is OK. we have a private bar + restaurant onsite. this is a state issue — guests do not have a liquor license, but the venue does

bullets.label: smoking is allowed
bullets.text: only in designated outdoor smoking areas

bullets.label: no illegal drugs
bullets.text: per idaho state law. this includes marijuana

bullets.label: fires allowed
bullets.text: in rings and kitchen stoves only

bullets.label: mind your footwear
bullets.text: prepare for snow outside + a dance floor inside

bullets.label: look after yourself and each other
bullets.text: please help the event organizers if you see anyone breaking these rules. we understand mistakes happen — organizers will stay aware

sections.heading: transportation
sections.intro: plan to drive or carpool to the site solo. no taxi / uber availability

bullets.label: driving in
bullets.text: venue is a 30-45 minute drive from jackson hole. there is ample parking onsite. rentals are available at jackson hole airport. please have a DD ready if you intend to drive home

bullets.label: carpooling in
bullets.text: rideshare details will be sent to ticket holders via email ~1 month before the event

bullets.label: flying in
bullets.text: venue is 45-60 minutes from jackson hole airport (JAC) — 1.5hrs from idaho falls (IDA) — 4hrs from salt lake city (SLC). we recommend you fly in thursday and arrange transportation in advance

bullets.label: uber / taxi service
bullets.text: uber / taxis are inconsistent in rural idaho. we recommend scheduling these 2+ days in advance via local services

sections.heading: phones + wifi
sections.intro: phones allowed. wifi available. be wise.

bullets.label: we invite you to unplug
bullets.text: phones are allowed, but discouraged. you'll find spaces to store your phone if it needs a time out

bullets.label: photos are welcome
bullets.text: we ask you to be aware that many guests come to escape. each LCD screen burns a pin hole in the container of the dance floor experience — just make your screen time count

sections.heading: what to pack
sections.intro: plan for below freezing with snowcover… and a ripping hot dance floor

bullets.label: dress warmly, wear layers
bullets.text: average temps are 15°F - 40°F in march. the dance floor & lodging are separate buildings. you will need to walk in the snow between them. coat racks will be available onsite for indoor-outdoor transitions

bullets.label: mind your footwear
bullets.text: bring shoes for snow travel + for dancing

bullets.label: bedding is provided
bullets.text: but feel free to bring extra pillows / comforts
outer shell (i.e. ski jacket, layerable rain coat)
insulated layer (i.e. puffer jacket, thick sweatshirt)
inner layer (i.e. fleece, sweatshirt)
base layer (i.e. long underwear)
socks (always +2 extra pairs)
warm beanie
outdoor shoes (durable & warm, semi-waterproof, wearable in 4" snow)
indoor shoes (comfortable, wearable on covered porch)
snow gloves (waterproof)
water bottle
headlamp
